THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FOLK & LANDSCAPE
057
STUDY 032
Pearls & Red Embroidery with a Stork
Rights check
Source: 24536.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with copper-red braids and
light freckles stands in a golden wheat field beside a
white stork with a red beak. She wears a red and white
embroidered high-necked dress with a lace collar,
several strands of pearls, and a brown leather strap
across her chest. Small silver drop earrings hang from
her ears. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft
daylight, a palette of wheat gold, crimson, cream, and
white. Striking and poised, in the style of a pastoral
editorial.
Striking, rustic, poised
WORKING NOTES
- The stork's red beak and the pearl strands are the focal
details.
- Adjust 'blue wildflowers' in the background for a different
season.
